name: many-eyes-pilot4
about: Pilot 4: does collective detection (alarm contagion) produce an evolved many-eyes effect? Predators present in both; alarm off vs on. Same seeds, setup and measurement window as pilot 3, whose no-predator runs are the no-predator control (with no predators nobody flees, so alarm has no effect). Prediction: food-adjusted vigilance slope negative with alarm on, flat with it off.
